headline: Chinese Yuan Touches Three-Week High Against Dollar Amid Corporate FX Conversion
summary: The Chinese yuan briefly touched its highest level against the dollar in three weeks, supported by greenback weakness and seasonal corporate demand to convert dollars.
why: Corporate foreign exchange conversion patterns and broad dollar fluctuations dictate short-term onshore yuan liquidity and exchange rates.

impacts.name: USD/CNY
impacts.why: Corporate dollar selling and greenback weakness strengthen the onshore yuan.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Seasonal corporate demand to swap foreign currency revenues into local tender, alongside general greenback softness, drove the yuan higher.
